sentences.text: 5. It is further the contention of the learned counsel that the petitioner intends to travel to Dubai alongwith his family for which purpose the permission to travel is required, as well as, his passport needs to be returned.
In this backdrop the aforesaid relief has been sought.
6. The learned APP has handed over the status report in Court, the same is taken on record.
He also points out that an application seeking similar relief has been filed by the petitioner before the learned Trial Court.
A copy of said application has also been annexed by the petitioner to the present petition.

7. In view of the bail condition, since the petitioner has been granted liberty by the learned Additional Sessions Judge to seek permission from the learned Trial Court for travelling abroad, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the present petition with liberty to pursue his aforesaid application before the learned Trial Court.
